title: Fizzl: safe payments for AI agents (ad, ~80 seconds, with Higgsfield clips)

segments.text: AI agents now pay for things on their own.
But who checks what they pay for?
A plain wallet signs whatever the agent asks. Fizzl checks first. Every time.
Bad payments are stopped. Good ones go through.
Before every signature: scams, drainers and sanctioned addresses are never signed.
And after every payment, the answer is checked too. Hidden instructions aimed at your agent? It is warned before it reads them.
You set the rules, in your own words.
Above your limit, one tap on your phone. No answer, no payment.
Your keys and your money stay with you. Always.
And x402 Doctor checks thirty-five thousand paid APIs every day, so your agent knows which ones really work.
Fizzl. Safe payments for AI agents. Free to start, at fizzl.eu.
